model.name: Qwen Image 2.1 7B
model.description: Unified image generation and editing with up to 10 reference images, control-image transfer, inpainting, LanPaint and outpainting. Start with 40 steps, CFG 4 and 1024px, or select a Viggle Turbo acceleration profile. Native 2K uses roughly 4.2 megapixels and needs more memory. Qwen Research License: non-commercial research/evaluation only; commercial use requires a separate license from Qwen. Only Qwen Image 2.1 7B LoRAs are compatible.
